info.name: LSE Controlled Unauthenticated Admin Status

info.description: A controlled fixture rule that identifies an unauthenticated administrative status response.

metadata.customer-summary: 目标在未提供身份凭据时返回了管理状态信息。

response:

Connection: close
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 03:41:09 GMT

{"admin":true,"status":"ready"}
